import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path
sources = [
    "prompts/_shared/core-directives.xml",
    "prompts/bot-00-programming-lead.xml",
    "prompts/bot-01-systems-backend.xml",
    "prompts/bot-02-web-edge.xml",
    "prompts/bot-03-android.xml",
    "prompts/bot-04-ios.xml",
    "prompts/bot-05-infrastructure.xml",
    "prompts/bot-06-quality-security.xml",
]
seats = ["LEAD", "SYSTEMS", "WEB", "ANDROID", "IOS", "INFRA", "QUALITY"]
decl = '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>'
problems = []
for path in sources:
    try:
        ET.parse(path)
    except ET.ParseError as exc:
        problems.append(f"{path}: {exc}")
for seat in seats:
    for folder in ("prompts", "prompts-assembled"):
        path = Path(folder) / f"{seat}.xml"
        text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        docs = [p for p in text.split(decl) if p.strip()]
        if len(docs) != 2:
            problems.append(f"{path}: expected 2 xml documents, got {len(docs)}")
            continue
        for i, doc in enumerate(docs):
            try:
                ET.fromstring(decl + doc)
            except ET.ParseError as exc:
                problems.append(f"{path} part {i}: {exc}")
print(problems or "ok")
raise SystemExit(0 if not problems else 1)
PY

problems = []

seats = {el.attrib["name"]: el.attrib.get("in_channel") for el in roster}
expect = {
    "LEAD": "true",
    "SYSTEMS": "true",
    "WEB": "true",
    "ANDROID": "true",
    "IOS": "true",
    "INFRA": "true",
    "QUALITY": "false",
}
if seats != expect:
    problems.append(f"seats {seats}")
labels = {
    "SYSTEMS": "Systems & Design",
    "WEB": "Web & Desktop",
    "ANDROID": "Android & Play Release",
    "IOS": "iOS & App Store",
    "INFRA": "Infra & WEB3",
    "QUALITY": "Quality & Security",
}
for el in roster:
    text = "".join(el.itertext())
    want = labels.get(el.attrib["name"])
    if want and want not in text:
        problems.append(f"{el.attrib['name']} text missing {want}")
quality = ET.parse("prompts/bot-06-quality-security.xml").getroot()
roles = [el.attrib.get("role") for el in quality.iter("channel")]
if "off_channel_post_build" not in roles:
    problems.append(f"QUALITY channel roles {roles}")
core = Path("prompts/_shared/core-directives.xml").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
doc = Path("docs/desk-operating-model.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
if "widgets/cards do not render in group rooms" not in core:
    problems.append("core missing widget rule")
if "Numbered selectable options live in the Desk. Widgets do not render in rooms." not in core:
    problems.append("core missing numbered-option rule")
if "Members (6): LEAD, SYSTEMS, WEB, ANDROID, IOS, INFRA." not in doc:
    problems.append("operating model missing six-member roster")
role_by_seat = {
    "SYSTEMS": "Systems and Design Engineer",
    "WEB": "Web and Desktop Engineer",
    "ANDROID": "Android and Play Release Engineer",
    "IOS": "iOS and App Store Engineer",
    "INFRA": "Infrastructure and WEB3 Engineer",
    "QUALITY": "Quality and Security Engineer",
}
for seat, role in role_by_seat.items():
    for folder in ("prompts", "prompts-assembled"):
        text = Path(folder, f"{seat}.xml").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        if role not in text:
            problems.append(f"{folder}/{seat}.xml missing {role}")
        if "widgets/cards do not render in group rooms" not in text:
            problems.append(f"{folder}/{seat}.xml missing widget rule")
lead_asm = Path("prompts-assembled/LEAD.xml").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
if 'name="QUALITY"' not in lead_asm or 'in_channel="false"' not in lead_asm:
    problems.append("assembled LEAD missing QUALITY out of channel")
print(problems or "ok")
raise SystemExit(0 if not problems else 1)
